---
"config-version": 8 #   c1 with words
observability: {logs: {debug: false, logging-to-file: true}, usage: {usage-statistics-enabled: false}, pprof: {enable: true}} #c2
# c3
'plugins': {"enabled": false, store-sources: ["https://store.example/index.json"]} # c4

# c5
routing: &m6 # c7
  retry: {'request-retry': 3, max-retry-interval: 1}
  # c8
  'cooldown': {transient-error-cooldown-seconds: -1} #   c9 with words

oauth:
  auth-dir: 'C:\auth' # c10
  # c11
  settings:
    vertex: #c12
      #c13
      - name: m2
        # c14
        alias: '' #   c15 with words
        #c16
#   c17 with words
        max-context-length: 272000 #   c18 with words
      - 'name': ' gemini-2.5-pro '
        alias: 'sol'
        max-context-length: 200000 # c19
      #c20
      - name: 'İstanbul'
        alias: "Pro" # c21
        # c22
        "max-context-length": 0 # c23
  #c24
  "request-scoped-errors":
    #   c25 with words
    antigravity: [{status: 400, action: "stop", match: ['claude-2*']}, {status: 500, action: '', match: ["claude-2*", '<tag>']}]
    # c26
# c27
management: {allow-remote: true, disable-control-panel: false, disable-auto-update-panel: true, secret-key: '', panel-github-repository: 'https://github.com/example/panel'}

"requests":
  payload: {default: [{'models': [{"name": '*', protocol: "codex"}, {name: '*', protocol: "claude"}], params: {reasoning.effort: 4096, "max_output_tokens": true}}, {models: [{name: 'gemini-*', protocol: openai}, {name: 'gpt-*'}], params: {reasoning.effort: 0, store: true}}], default-raw: [{models: [{name: "claude-sonnet-4-6", protocol: gemini}], params: {max_output_tokens: null, "store": false}}], override: [{models: [{'name': "gemini-*", protocol: "gemini"}, {name: '*', protocol: openai}], params: {generationConfig.thinkingConfig: 1, metadata: 2}}, {models: [{name: claude-sonnet-4-6}], params: {tools.0.name: 1.0}}], override-raw: [{models: [{name: "*", protocol: openai}, {name: 'gpt-*', protocol: claude}], 'params': {store: true}}]} #   c28 with words
  nonstream-keepalive-interval: 5 # c29
  #   c30 with words

#   c31 with words
'x-extension':
#c32
  owner: |- #c33
    ops
  # c34
  # c35
  notes: ["first", 'second note']
  #   c36 with words
  # c37
  limits: {burst: 10} # c38
  #c39

comment_free_options.file:
'config-version': 8
plugins:
  'enabled': true
  dir: ferry-plugins
'observability':
  logs:
    'logging-to-file': true
    error-logs-max-files: 10
    "logs-max-total-size-mb": -1
  usage:
    redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: -1
  pprof:
    enable: true
    addr: "0.0.0.0:6060"
oauth:
  request-scoped-errors:
    gemini-cli:
      - status: 0
        action: 'continue'
        match:
          - '*-preview'
      - status: 400
        action: stop
        match:
          - |-
            GPT-5.5-MINI
    qwen:
      - status: 500
        action: |-
          stop
        match:
          - gpt-5.5-mini
        match-regexr:
          - '^context.*$'
      - 'status': &s5 0
        "action": ''
        match-regexr:
          - '^context.*$'
  excluded-models:
    gemini-cli:
      - ""
      - "GPT-5.5-MINI"
    "codex":
      - gpt-5.5-mini
      - " gemini-1.5-* "
      - "gpt-5.5-mini"
    vertex:
      - '<tag>'
      - ' gemini-1.5-* '
      - ""
x-extension:
  owner: &s11 ops
